ns2:section.sectionText: IAN HOBSON PIANO MASTERCLASS. This course is open to students who would like to participate in a half-hour piano masterclass with Ian Hobson. Six masterclasses are scheduled for Spring 2020: (1) Monday, February 3 from 9:30 am–12:00 pm in 220 Smith Memorial Room; (2) Tuesday, February 4 from 1:00–3:20 pm in 114 Smith Recital Hall; (3) Wednesday, March 25 from 9:30 am–12:00 pm in 220 Smith Memorial Room; (4) Thursday, March 26 from 1:00–3:20 pm in 114 Smith Recital Hall; (5) Friday, April 24 from 10:00 am–12:30 pm in Foellinger Great Hall; and (6) Friday, April 24 from 2:30–5:00 pm in Foellinger Great Hall.
